Kindful as a standalone donor management product has been **rolled into the Bloomerang platform**, so Kindful customers are being moved to or replaced by **Bloomerang CRM / Bloomerang’s fundraising suite**.[1][3][2]

Essential points:

- **Acquisition and discontinuation:** Bloomerang acquired Kindful in 2021, bringing Kindful’s donor management and online fundraising tools into the Bloomerang product line.[1] Kindful is now listed as “discontinued, now part of Bloomerang.”[2]  
- **Current branding:** The Kindful site now identifies **“Kindful is a Bloomerang Product”** and directs users to “Boost fundraising with Bloomerang’s built for purpose giving platform.”[3]  
- **Practical replacement:** For existing Kindful users, the intended replacement/upgrade path is **Bloomerang’s CRM and giving platform**, which incorporates Kindful-style features (online donation pages, donor management, reporting, integrations) under the Bloomerang brand.[1][3]  

If you meant “what other tools can I use instead of Kindful,” common alternatives frequently listed include **Bloomerang CRM**, Bonterra/EveryAction, Salesforce for Nonprofits, Blackbaud CRM, and others, depending on your size and needs.[2][4][6]
